values.note: Black Hawk County's rate sheet (dated November 2024), shared by its five campgrounds Siggelkow included, charges per camping unit: $18 a night for camping without hookups, $25 with electricity, $30 full hookup; $30 electric and $35 full hookup with a reservation. Which site types Siggelkow has is not posted; no full-hookup or online-reservable sites are listed for it.

fees.source: https://content.mycountyparks.com/Production/RelatedItem/Content/facb0609-617f-4251-81ad-57b04d2253b7 ('Rates' PDF linked from the Siggelkow park page, created 2024-11-22): 'McFarlane Park, Black Hawk Park, Big Woods Lake Campground, Hickory Hills Park & Siggelkow Park ... Camping - $18.00/night, Electricity - $25.00/night, Full Hook-Up - $30.00/night', read 2026-11-04

facilities.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Black-Hawk/Park/Siggelkow-Park (read 2026-11-04) names no facilities beyond camping and river access; the derived drinking water, no-showers and dump values came from unsourced note prose and are cleared. (Travel Iowa's stale listing says only 'Campground with electric, water and a picnic shelter'.)

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Black-Hawk/Park/Siggelkow-Park (read 2026-11-04) states no booking policy and lists no reservable sites; the county rate sheet prices reservations for its campgrounds generally. The derived 'not reservable, always FCFS' came from note prose and is cleared.

note: Black Hawk County Conservation campground off Fairbank Road north of Dunkerton, the county's first access to the Wapsi River Water Trail, with a canoe/kayak launch. The camping area is a small wooded strip between the entrance road and a pond; the river is out of sight behind the woods. --Claude
summary: Rate found: the county's Nov 2024 rate sheet, which names Siggelkow, gives $18 no hookups and $25 electric, so fees are 18-25. The park page gives no site count, facilities or booking policy, so the derived facilities and booking values (from note prose) were cleared. Not waterfront stands: the sites are beside a ~1.5-acre pond, and the Wapsipinicon is ~200-300 m west behind forest. The stored evidence wrongly names the Cedar River. The pin is in a field south of Fairbank Rd, and the camping strip is ~180 m north.
flags: WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' stands, but the stored waterfront_evidence is wrong on two counts: it names the 'Cedar River' (it is the Wapsipinicon) and it was read at the stored pin, which is in a farm field south of Fairbank Rd, not at the campground. Re-read from the county's park map and NAIP: the camping icon and pads sit in a grassy wooded strip between the entrance road and a pond. The pond's open water is ~55 x 130 m, about 1.5 acres (imagery estimate), so it is under the 5-acre line with no value. The Wapsipinicon (~30-40 m wide, imagery estimate; Overpass down) loops ~200-300 m west and north behind continuous forest. Its water-access launches are at the north end of the park drive and by the parking lot by Fairbank Rd, away from the sites.

PIN MOVE: stored 42.63470,-92.14080 is in the open field SOUTH of Fairbank Rd, outside the park. The camping strip (pads/tables visible on NAIP, the camping icon on the county map) is at about 42.63629,-92.14088, ~177 m north across the road. Under the 250 m line, but on the wrong side of a county road.

SITE COUNT / HOOKUPS / FIT: no operator page gives a count, hookups or pad lengths. Travel Iowa's listing (flagged by its own site as not updated in 12+ months) says 'Campground with electric, water'. Imagery shows a small area, perhaps 5-10 sites. Electric not written; worth a call to 319-433-7275.
BOOKING: the park page has no reservable facility listings, unlike Black Hawk Park and Big Woods Lake, which suggests first-come camping, but no page says so. Cleared rather than kept on inference.

FEES: the rate sheet is county-wide (dated 2024-11-22 and still the linked 'Rates' document). The $18 low assumes Siggelkow has a non-hookup site a 23-ft motorhome can use, and that is not stated. If every site is electric, the low should be 25.
PHONE 319-433-7275 confirmed (park page 'Contact Us'; the map's '(319) 433-PARK'). WEBSITE OK (the stored lower-case slug resolves to the same page).
